race.comment: SERENADING (1) is a promising mare resuming for the Beasley camp. Clearly has her share of ability and gets the key booking of Loy. Can return with a bang. SHE'S THE KEY (7) stuck on gamely into the placings fresh and is a likely improver second-up. Is drawn to advantage on the inside and if she gets her own way in front. REDS CITY (6) bounced straight back to winning form last start when scoring with a bit in hand at Narrandera. Keeps the 2kg claimer engaged and comes right into the mix after some key scratchings. INITIATE (5) returns and looks best of the rest.
